title: Macron Bans Illegitimate Protests Following Riots

beats.text: Macron bans protests in parts of Paris as France braces for more unrest.
More than half a million people gathered across France on Saturday.
Students demanded better conditions in schools and groups denounced high living costs.
Masked protesters clashed with police, looted shops, and set vehicles on fire.
President Macron blamed seditious acts by ultra-left groups for trying to bring down the Republic.
Authorities barred demonstrations in Paris, Lyon, Lille, and Grenoble.
Demonstrations organised by recognised groups like trade unions will be offered alternative routes.
Macron announced plans to convene a defence council meeting on Friday to review the security situation.
